claims: NASA's Artemis II mission launched from Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis II mission lifted off on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
Artemis II mission lifted off atop the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis II mission began a 10-day journey around the moon.
The launch location is Kennedy Space Center, Cape Canaveral, Florida.
LC-39B is the same site used for Apollo missions.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission of the Artemis program.
The Artemis II launch was the first crewed flight to the Moon in over 50 years.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket sent four astronauts around the moon.
The four astronauts are Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
